properties.description: A new design mints a name of its own, it survives reopening, two designs are told apart, an unreadable identity is refused rather than defaulted, the label changes while the id cannot — and the migration case: a store already holding a design under the shared id KEEPS it and stays readable. Closes with the payoff: two independently created ON-DISK designs mirroring each other's published surface, which was impossible while every graph shared one constant (tests/design_identity.rs, 7 cases)
properties.name: A design mints a name of its own, and two designs are told apart
